description: Generate an image from text, optionally with reference images for style/content guidance. MODELS: gen4_image (high quality), gen4_image_turbo (fast/cheap), gemini_2.5_flash (Google Gemini), gemini_image3_pro (Nano Banana Pro, up to 4K), gpt_image_2_6_sunburst and gpt_image_2_6_flare (OpenAI GPT Image 2.6, up to 4K), gemini_image3.1_flash (512px to 4K), gemini_image3.1_flash_lite (1K, cheap), nano_banana_2.1 (1K to 4K), seedream5.5 (ByteDance, 1K to 2K), minimax_h3_image (1K to 4K, up to 16 references), ideogram_4_5 (strong at text in images), grok_imagine_image_2 (xAI, 1K/2K), muse_image (cheapest, 1 credit), bria_fibo_1_5 (1MP/4MP, takes a seed). Models made by others take only their own options; a wrong one is refused with the reason, nothing is charged. Their prices are estimated from Runway's published rates. REFERENCE IMAGES: Tag with short label (e.g., "cat"), use @tag in prompt. Tags work with gen4, gemini and nano_banana models. gpt_image_2_6 takes tags but ignores them, and the other models made by others refuse them: with those, refer to references by order ("the first image"). WORKFLOW: Returns task_id → poll with check_runway_task or use wait_for_runway_task.

prompt_text.description: Text description. Use @tag to reference images (gpt_image_2_6: "the first image", "the second image").

ratio.description: Output size as W:H. Each model takes its own set; an unsupported one is refused with the list. Default: 1920:1080 for Runway models; about 16:9 at 1K for the others (gpt_image_2_6: 1920:1088). gpt_image_2_6, ideogram_4_5 and muse_image also take auto; ideogram_4_5 with reference images takes 1024:576 in place of 1280:720 (likewise 576:1024, 1408:704, 704:1408).

reference_images.description: Optional reference images: 1-3 for Runway models; up to 16 for gpt_image_2_6 and minimax_h3_image, 14 for gemini models, 10 for seedream5.5 and muse_image, 5 ideogram_4_5, 3 grok_imagine_image_2, 1 bria_fibo_1_5.

tag.description: Tag for @mention in prompt. 3-16 lowercase chars.

uri.description: HTTPS URL, Runway URI, or local file path.

name: generate_image
